name: Microgrid storage grid-following availability input
summary: Receives the declared capability to follow an available AC reference under the assigned conditions.
description: Receives the declared capability to follow an available AC reference under the assigned conditions. Storage coordination combines the battery's energy limits with the converter's electrical capability and the microgrid's operating demand. State of charge, allowable power and connection status describe different aspects of availability.

In a microgrid with a battery energy storage system, the controller can request discharge to support a power deficit while the battery management and conversion systems enforce their own operating limits. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Storage operating capability” at the input and “Grid-following availability” at the output. A valid external reference may be required.
